shape.subjectTooLong: Subject is {len} characters; the limit is {max}. Put detail in the work-graph node or the lesson catalog.
shape.bodyTooManyLines: Body has {n} prose lines; the limit is {max} (structured lines and trailers are not counted).
shape.bodyTooLong: Body prose is {n} characters; the limit is {max}.
shape.structuredTooLong: "{prefix}" line is {n} characters; the limit is {max}.
shape.roundsNotInteger: "{line}" must be a whole number, got "{value}".
shape.thirdRoundMissing: {rounds} review rounds exceed the limit of {max}; add "{line} <signal> — <reason>" naming the independent signal (test, mutation run, real measurement) that justified it.
shape.impactMissing: Staged paths need an impact table ({paths}); add a "{line}" line, or "{line} not needed — <reason>".
shape.allowNoReason: "{marker}" needs a reason of at least 8 characters before the closing bracket.
sidecopy.header: Rules that apply to {relPath} in the project (you are working in a side copy, where path-scoped rules do not load):
sidecopy.tooLarge: Rules that apply to {relPath} in the project (too large to inline; read them with the Read tool):
push.warn: {n} commits are waiting to be pushed (threshold {max}). Ask for push approval; large batches hide which change broke what.
push.unmeasured: Unpushed commit count could not be measured (no upstream branch).
push.ok: {n} commits are waiting to be pushed (threshold {max}).
impact.q.S1: Who else reads or decides this?
impact.q.S2: Which other paths reach this state?
impact.q.S3: What is newly accepted or rejected?
impact.q.S4: What happens at the ceiling, or when measurement fails?
impact.q.S5: Where do the fakes come from?
impact.col.question: Question
impact.reason.gitFailed: git could not read the repository: {error}
impact.reason.registryUnreadable: ceiling registry {path} is not valid JSON: {error}
impact.s1.refs: {n} references in {files} files (tests and metrics.excludeRe paths left out)
impact.s1.noTwinRoot: the input files are under no twin root
impact.s1.noCoChange: no file changed together with the input files in at least {min} commits
impact.s2.none: none of the {n} other referencing files looks like an entry point (route, handler, cron, scheduler, cli, import, webhook, job)
impact.s3.found: tests and corpora next to the input files:
impact.s3.buildCorpus: no test or corpus next to the input files: build an accept + reject corpus and a failing test first
impact.s4.noEntries: no entry mentions the input files
impact.s5.importsWithFakes: {test} imports the module and builds fakes
impact.s5.allSourced: every fake cites a recorded fixture
impact.s5.none: no test mocks or imports the input files
rework.summary: Rework: {reworked} of {commits} commits ({pct}) had lines changed by a fix within {days} days.
rework.none: Rework: no candidate commits in the range (rate unmeasured).
cli.stagedUnmeasured: Staged paths could not be read ({error}); the impact-line check ran without them.
impact.s5.noFakes: no test builds fakes of the input files
rework.fixMajority: Note: {fixes} of {commits} candidate commits are fixes. When most work is labelled fix, this rate measures churn, not defect rework; narrow metrics.fixSubject.
sidecopy.cannotRun: ennyn side-copy rule hook cannot run: {reason}
rework.censored: {n} commits newer than {days} days were left out: their window has not closed.
gate.none: No gate attempts recorded yet ({path}). The commit wrapper records them with `ennyn gate-record`.
gate.skipped: {n} lines in {path} are not gate attempts and were skipped.
gate.emptyWindow: No gate attempts in this range.
gate.summary: Gate: {full} attempts, {passed} passed, {failed} failed ({pct}); {message} messages rejected before the gate.
gate.passTime: Passing attempts: median {median} min, p90 {p90} min.
gate.failTime: Failed attempts: median {median} min, p90 {p90} min; {wasted} min spent in failed attempts.
gate.stepsUnmeasured: {n} failed attempts did not name the failing step (unmeasured, not clean).
